in_arabic.name: ولياة
in_arabic.meaning: والدة أو أم أو وصية أو قريبة أو صديقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ولياة مشتق من ولي الذي يعني القريب أو الصديق أو الحامي. في اللغة العربية، يعني ولياة والدة أو أم أو وصية أو قريبة أو صديقة. اسم ولياة يوحي بالحماية والرعاية والاهتمام.

in_urdu.name: ولیات
in_urdu.meaning: والدہ یا ام یا وصیہ یا قریبی یا دوست
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام ولیات عربی زبان کے لفظ ولي سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے قریب یا دوست یا حامی۔ اردو میں، ولیات کا مطلب والدہ یا ام یا وصیہ یا قریبی یا دوست ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام حفاظت اور دیکھ بھال اور احترام کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: वलियात
in_hindi.meaning: माता या मां या अभिभावक या करीबी या मित्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: वलियात नाम अरबी भाषा के शब्द ولي से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है करीबी या मित्र या रक्षक। हिंदी में, वलियात का अर्थ माता या मां या अभिभावक या करीबी या मित्र होता है। यह नाम सुरक्षा और देखभाल और सम्मान की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ولياة
in_pashto.meaning: مورنۍ یا ماما یا سرپرست یا نږدې یا ملګرې
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ولياة نوم د عربي کلمې ولي څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې نږدې یا دوست یا ساتونکی دی. په پښتو کې، ولياة معنی مورنۍ یا ماما یا سرپرست یا نږدې یا ملګرې لري. دا نوم د خوندیتوب او پاملرنې او درناوي مفهوم څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Waliyat
in_english.meaning: Mother, guardian, close relative, or friend
in_english.long_meaning: The name Waliyat originates from the Arabic root 'wali,' which means close relative, friend, or protector. In Islamic tradition, Waliyat signifies a maternal figure, guardian, or a close associate. It embodies qualities of protection, care, and spiritual guidance. Historically, the term has been used to denote a woman of piety and devotion. The name Waliyat reflects a sense of responsibility, nurturing, and guardianship.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Waliyat" holds great cultural significance in Islamic traditions. It is commonly used to refer to the spiritual guides or patrons in Sufism, the mystic branch of Islam. These spiritual guides or saints have a deep understanding of the Quran and the Hadith and devote their lives to promoting the teachings of Islam to others. They are revered as important figures within their communities, guiding people to live righteous lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The term "Waliyat" carries significant spiritual meaning as well. In Islamic belief, every Muslim is believed to have a Wali or guardian, often a deceased relative, who intercedes on their behalf before Allah. The Waliyat, then, symbolizes the connection between the physical world and the spiritual world, representing Allah’s love, guidance, and protection for humanity. By serving and supporting others, a Waliyat embodies the compassionate and caring nature of Allah, fulfilling their duty as a steward of Allah’s creation.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Waliyat was a title given to prominent companions of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Waliyat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Waliyat was a title given to those who were entrusted with the care and protection of the Prophet Muhammad and his community in Medina after his migration from Mecca.
